QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: enabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Enable simulation object receiver
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Receive read-only simulation object traffic on an explicit UDP socket.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: bindAddress
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Simulation listener interface
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Numeric local IP address. Use 0.0.0.0 only with a trusted peer allow-list.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: allowedSender
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Trusted simulation sender IP
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Exact numeric source IP, not a hostname.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: completedRetentionMs
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Completed missile retention (ms)
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: How long to retain an explicitly ended simulation object.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: staleTimeoutMs
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Simulation stale threshold (ms)
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Network staleness based on monotonic receive time.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: removalTimeoutMs
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Simulation stale removal (ms)
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Remove stale objects from the active model without considering them completed.
